function: Multi-target counting and localization (device-free sensing) from estimated mmWave CSI with a transformer (CSIformer); localization is not one of the seven areas, reason function (p. 1, p. 6).
notes: Exclude, reason function: the learned method performs target counting and localization (sensing), which is not the problem of any of the seven areas. p. 1: "called CSIformer, is designed to extract the most effective features for sensing"; p. 6: "We train separate CSIformer architectures for the counting and localization tasks." The paper calls itself ISAC, p. 3: "we propose a new ISAC framework for simultaneous counting and localization of multiple targets", but the learned part designs no beams, waveforms, or resources (area 5), p. 2: "it is not possible to optimize or adapt the waveform design, beamforming, or power allocation"; and channel estimation is classical, not learned (area 2), p. 4: "For simplicity, we use the Least Square Estimator (LSE)". Earlier checks pass: a research article that proposes and evaluates a learned (transformer) method on CSI, not above the physical layer. The PDF matches the DOI (title and DOI on p. 1).
